## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 8, 2026 - Jul 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Natalia Carlos Diaz_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "The update regarding hearts and the "check-in" feature was terrible. As someone who has been using Doki Chat for a long time, freezing the daily hearts felt like a low blow; I mean, that feature helped drive regular visits to the app and served as a sort of reward. Now, everything has to be paid for. Sure, you can still get hearts by watching ads, but having to sit through them is annoying. It was—and still is—the best app, but those updates... 🤢Please remove the payment "check-in" update"
            2. _Haru Mcrmbng_, Jul 22, 2026, 1/5: "everything was good,the app was great to be general until you have to "pay" for the "daily rewards"?????its disappointing actually, it keep updating almost every day that it end up with bugs and really no wonder why the messangers and authors are lowkey getting low and disappearing with the new update nothing is free😔"
            3. _Irislene Oliveira Silva_, Jun 19, 2026, 1/5: "There are a lot of bugs. The app has good stories and a beautiful interface, but it crashes frequently and sometimes stops responding, making reading difficult. It has potential, but needs more stability and optimization to offer a better experience."
